gizmo.title: Tautohu wāhi wera
gizmo.description: Ka kimi ngā ākonga i ngā wāhi tika i tētahi atahanga mā te pāwhiri, te pātō, te neke rānei i tētahi ripeka papapātuhi. Te hoa kōeke o te mahere atahanga.

configure.title: Atahanga
configure.description: Te pikitia e rapua ana e ngā ākonga.

configure.title: Kuputuhi kē
configure.description: Ka whakaahua i te pikitia mō te hunga kāore e kite. Kāore rawa e whakaaturia hei taitara.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: He taitara poto e kitea ana i runga ake i te pikitia.

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: Te mea e tonoa ana ngā ākonga kia kimihia i te pikitia.

configure.title: Ngā whakautu
configure.description: He porotītaha whai ingoa ia whakautu i te pikitia. Ko te tūranga me te rahi he ōrau o te pikitia, ka inea mai i tōna kokonga mauī o runga. I te wā whakatika, ka tāhuhia ia whakautu i te pikitia.

advanced.title: Ngā ngana
advanced.description: E hia ngā wā ka taea e te ākonga te ngana. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he tepe.

advanced.title: Ngā hapa e whakaaetia ana
advanced.description: E hia ngā hapa ka whakamutu i tētahi ngana. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he tepe, ā, ka whiwhi ngā ākonga i tētahi pātene Whakaoti.

advanced.title: Ka taea te kōpaki
advanced.description: Whakaaturia tēnei pātai hei rārangi ka tuwhera, ka kati hoki. Ka kati te whakatuwhera i tētahi i ētahi atu pātai kōpaki i tōna taha.

advanced.title: Tīmata kua kōpakina
advanced.description: Ina taea te kōpaki, tīmata hei rārangi kua kati e whakaatu ana i te pātai me tōna tūnga anake.

advanced.title: Hōputu kōeke
advanced.description: OER Schema: hōputu kōeke mō tēnei aromatawai (hei tauira, ngā piro, te reta, te ōrau, te whakaoti).

advanced.title: Whāinga ako
advanced.description: OER Schema: te whāinga ako e hāngai ana ki tēnei aromatawai.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Te ingoa pātaitai ka tukuna mō te whakamahi i ngā taiao e akiakina ana e xAPI hei tautohu i tēnei tūemi

developer.title: Akoranga
developer.description: OER Schema: te akoranga e whakaritea ana tēnei aromatawai.
